name: LogRow
description: Single row of a logs feed — composes the dot/icon, timestamp, and message into one entry

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the row container

fields.name: body
fields.description: Body text; `|`-separated values are split into separate lines

fields.name: status
fields.description: Severity / status string (`'Critical'`, `'High'`, `'Medium'`, activity status, etc.)
